title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned The Drawing Set. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: The Drawing Set
options.thesis: The group presented as one drawn set: every sector a drafted assembly, every stage a construction phase.
options.viewport: One continuous drawing sheet: the investment thesis set as the sheet title, the Africa-to-World mechanism drawn in section, and a stamped primary action inside the title block.
options.risk: Reads cold and technical if the content is thin; must never fall into literal blueprint-cyan.

raised.raise: One continuous sheet owns the whole first viewport, never boxed sections.
Total coverage: every surface is drafting material, no neutral filler left anywhere.
Addressability: every sheet number and annotation is a real deep link, navigable like an index.

options.label: The Bridge Chart
options.thesis: The Africa-to-World bridge as a working chart: ports, routes, and the four footprint states as a live legend.
options.viewport: A live two-way route chart over a deep-ocean ground, the investment thesis set top-left, a footprint-state legend bottom-right.
options.risk: This is where most runs in the category land; a map reads decorative when the underlying data is thin.

options.label: The Modular Identity
options.lineage: modular identity programs (photography + hard vector bars)
options.thesis: The multi-entity group as one modular system: photographed reality locking into a strict block grid.
options.viewport: A photographic panel overrun by saturated colour bars that snap to an invisible module, the group name in a neutral grotesque.
options.case: Fuses well: the eight platforms and five entities map cleanly to modules, and overlapping bars produce the system's own secondary colours. Loses on institutional quiet.
options.risk: Loud saturated blocks read gimmicky at institutional scale.

options.label: The Daylight Section
options.lineage: architectural section with live solar path
options.thesis: The group's impact shown as one building section, with daylight computing across it hour by hour.
options.viewport: One long section, rooms cut in charcoal poche, a gold sun band crossing as the active element, solar time stamped beneath.
options.case: Fuses: sustainability becomes a live computation rather than a claim. Loses the investment mechanism to a domestic, human scale.
options.risk: Human-scale warmth can undersell an investment mandate.

options.label: The Index Terminal
options.thesis: The group as a broadcast index: platforms and markets as numbered pages in a strict cell grid.
options.viewport: A P100 index page, platforms as numbered rows, the thesis in a block-mosaic panel, a REVEAL state over the restricted data room.
options.case: Fuses: a numbered index is instantly legible and a REVEAL state fits gated investor material. Loses warmth and audience identification.
options.risk: Reads retro-novelty when the grid is not held strictly.

options.label: The Alphabet Storm
options.thesis: Grammar becomes weather that reshapes the landscape.
options.viewport: Letters condensing into a word, then breaking into rain.
options.case: Fuses poorly: institutional financiers do not identify with surreal type-weather, and it hides the offer.
options.risk: Illegible for the audience it must convince.
options.kept: Total environmental commitment: one field, no boxed sections.

options.label: The Lacquer Panel
options.thesis: Every element packed into one outlined, lacquered tableau.
options.viewport: Figures at competing scales held by black outlines across the whole board.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no audience identification for an investment group and the crowding hides the offer.
options.kept: Total surface coverage: one edge system holds every element, no unpainted ground.

options.label: The Card Stack
options.thesis: The group as a stack of linked cards you can also author.
options.viewport: A black-and-white card with hand-painted buttons, back retracing your trail.
options.case: Fuses poorly: the one-bit nostalgic aesthetic undercuts 'modern, trustworthy, global', and browse/author duality confuses a public gateway.
options.risk: Signals retro software, not institutional scale.
options.kept: Addressability: every content unit is a deep link with an exact trail back.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: What this category ships, executed impeccably.
canonCard.viewport: Dark photographic hero, the promise set large in serif, a stat row, a sector-card grid, a footprint map, a contact CTA.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from the competition by design.
